title: About

hero.alt: Street frontage of the Together Wellness studio

seoDescription: Together Wellness is a physiotherapist-led studio in Mosman Park bringing physiotherapy, Pilates and wellbeing together under one roof.

blocks.title: Whole of body. Whole of life.

blocks.text: Rooted in the belief that feeling well is about more than physical health, our approach brings together purposeful movement, personalised care and meaningful connection.

blocks.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Together Wellness is a new destination for movement, health and wellbeing, with our first studio in Mosman Park.
We bring together expert physiotherapy, considered Pilates and a more personal approach to wellbeing, in a space designed around the way we move, feel and live.

slides.alt: Reception lounge with timber joinery and a planted pot
slides.caption: Reception. Artist’s impression

blocks.heading: Our approach
paragraphs: The body is an integrated system, and each stage of life asks something different of it. Our care is built around the whole person and the stage they are in.
We favour active care, and every session includes education, so you understand what is happening and how to look after yourself between visits.

slides.alt: Hands resting on a knee, black and white
slides.caption: Whole of body

blocks.heading: Physiotherapist-led
paragraphs: Our physiotherapists assess and treat, program our classes, and train every reformer instructor through more than 80 hours of theory, practical assessment and mentored teaching.

slides.alt: Clinical Pilates studio with trapeze table and chair
slides.caption: Clinical Pilates studio. Artist’s impression

blocks.heading: Commitments
paragraphs: How we work matters as much as what we offer. These commitments shape the studio, the team and the way we show up in our community.

slides.alt: Two hands reaching towards each other
slides.caption: Community

blocks.heading: People
paragraphs: Physiotherapists, Pilates instructors and studio staff who share one way of working: care that is personal, evidence-informed and grounded in everyday life.
